The structure of Cd2Sn4Au2S10 (reduced formula CdSn2AuS5) crystallizes in the tetragonal space group I-42m (No. 121), with 18 atoms per unit cell distributed over five independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis identifies Au in tetrahedral S coordination and Cd in octahedral S coordination, while Sn centers show both four-coordinate and octahedral six-coordinate S environments. The geometric neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 18 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing contacts include corner-sharing between Au tetrahedra and Cd octahedra, corner-sharing between Sn tetrahedra and Cd octahedra, and edge-sharing between Cd octahedra.
